summary.text: Peter Janko is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 69 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Joe Sosnowski (R).
Janko is an engineer and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Janko was born in Morse, Germany, and attended Wilbur Wright College and Northeastern Illinois University.
His career experience includes working as an engineer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he led a $22 million project in 1999 to modernize the Illinois Tollway communications system.
Janko won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the survey he described himself as a lifelong activist and community advocate and said he helped secure funding to restore passenger rail service from Chicago to Rockford.
He listed online privacy and child safety, affordable housing and opposition to incentives for data centers among his policy priorities.
